name: claude-mods
description: Mods for Claude Code: looks, dashboards and small helpers.

plugins.name: neon-pilot
plugins.description: Mecha-cockpit look: a vector hangar with KX-07, HUD message plates, and a cockpit dashboard with mission alerts, a pre-push system check, and boss-fight combat alerts.

plugins.name: code-pet
plugins.description: A pixel pet in the side panel — a blob, corgi, shiba, cat or bunny in several coats, with your name for it — that eats passing tests, cheers commits, sulks at failures and grows up as you code.

plugins.name: boss-fight
plugins.description: Failing tests become a pixel boss whose HP is the failure count; each test run is a round and a green run defeats it. With neon-pilot on, KX-07 fights it.

plugins.name: safe-harbor
plugins.description: Guards dangerous tool calls in three levels (block, ask, warn), from rm -rf / and force-push to main to curl | sh and .env writes, with editable rules.

plugins.name: flight-recorder
plugins.description: A session black box: a waterfall of every turn's tool calls, the slowest and failed calls, and a Markdown export.

plugins.name: diff-radar
plugins.description: A radar scope of the working tree: changed files as blips by folder, recency, size and edit count, with a warning when one file keeps getting rewritten.

plugins.name: terminal-1983
plugins.description: A phosphor CRT look in green or amber: a scanline tube backdrop, square mono messages, a low hum, and a mainframe job log of tool calls.

plugins.name: branch-warden
plugins.description: Keeps Claude off main: asks or blocks before the first edit and every commit on a protected branch, suggests a branch, and shows it in the status line.

plugins.name: ink-paper
plugins.description: INK & PAPER 水墨书斋: a rice-paper look by day and lamp-lit ink by night, an ink-wash landscape backdrop, sealed messages, and the solar term and double hour in the status line.

plugins.name: seasons
plugins.description: SEASONS 四时: a look that changes by itself with the real season and time of day: cherry petals, fireflies, maple leaves or snow, each with its own palette in light and dark.

plugins.name: token-garden
plugins.description: A garden for the context window: each turn grows a plant by what it did, and the garden dries and wilts as the context fills, with a nudge to /compact before it's full.

plugins.name: pomodoro-pilot
plugins.description: Pomodoro timer for Claude Code: a countdown in the status line, toasts when focus and breaks end, quiet reminders during a break, and done-toasts held until the break is over.

plugins.name: secret-sniffer
plugins.description: Stops secrets before they land: scans what Claude writes into files and what a git commit stages for API keys, tokens, private keys and JWTs, and refuses the call with the value masked.

plugins.name: focus-lens
plugins.description: Set a goal for the session with /lens: it sits in the status line, Claude is told to stay within it, and a gentle toast says when a turn's edits seem to wander outside it.

plugins.name: standup-scribe
plugins.description: Keeps a daily log of commits, PRs, edited files, test runs and prompts per repository, and turns it into a yesterday / today / blockers standup with /scribe or the standup_log tool.

plugins.name: narrator
plugins.description: Narrates what Claude is doing in a literary voice (wuxia, detective, space opera or nature documentary): a line in the status bar for every tool call, and a toast at the moments that matter.
